drhp.business: Founded in 1988, the Company processes carefully selected raw granite into finished slabs and tiles at its Hosur (Tamil Nadu) and Jaipur plants, and since 2020 has also manufactured engineered quartz surfaces at Hosur. Products are sold to construction, home-renovation and interior-surface customers worldwide, with the Hosur plant operating as a 100% Export Oriented Unit and the Jaipur plant as a Special Economic Zone unit. The Company states an annual production capacity of one million square metres and a range of more than one hundred granite and quartz shades.

risks.note: The United States remained the Company's largest export destination, accounting for approximately 65% of total exports, with Europe around 25%, so developments in U.S. trade policy had a direct and material bearing on performance through the year.
risks.risk: Export-market concentration and dependence on US trade policy

risks.note: Reciprocal tariffs on Indian exports moved from 27% in April 2025 to roughly 50% by August 2025, briefly to 18% in February 2026, then were struck down and replaced by a temporary uniform 10% Section 122 surcharge - leaving a narrower, temporary and still-unresolved tariff environment with no lasting structural advantage.
risks.risk: Tariff regime instability and unresolved framework

risks.note: Vietnam, a key competing source for engineered quartz, negotiated its rate down to 20% in October 2025 while India's remained at or near 50%, and ocean freight from Vietnam to the US has historically been cheaper than from India - disadvantaging Indian-origin material on both tariff and logistics cost simultaneously.
risks.risk: Competitive disadvantage against competing origins on tariff and freight

risks.note: Shipments from India require 55 to 75 days to reach U.S. ports, so buyers could not determine landed cost when placing orders; many deferred procurement, postponed shipments and held lower inventory, causing slower order inflows, delayed dispatches and increased pricing pressure.

Polyester resin constitutes approximately 60% of the raw material cost of the Company's engineered quartz slabs; the closure of the Strait of Hormuz on 28 February 2026 tightened global petrochemical supply and upward cost pressure was already visible in the final weeks of FY26.
risks.risk: Polyester resin / petrochemical input cost exposure

risks.note: Raw material availability is the foremost industry challenge, made more acute by recurring mining bans on environmental and regulatory grounds in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, limiting access to premium raw granite, disrupting supply chains and raising production costs.
risks.risk: Raw material availability and mining restrictions

risks.note: FY26 capacity utilisation was 12.14% for Hosur Tiles, 10.00% for Hosur Slabs, 23.71% for Jaipur Slabs and 20.55% for Hosur Quartz, leaving a heavy fixed-cost base spread over low volumes.

In Bengaluru, a key domestic market, real-estate projects faced significant delays in Occupancy Certificates, e-khata records and NOCs from fire, pollution-control and utility authorities; together with cautious developer and homeowner spending and increased competition from alternative construction materials, this weighed on demand and kept pricing competitive.
risks.risk: Domestic demand held back by approval delays and material substitution

sk.overview: India's gems and jewellery retail industry - covering gold jewellery, studded (diamond/coloured stone) jewellery and other (silver/platinum) jewellery plus gold bars and coins - was estimated at Rs 12,887 billion in fiscal 2026 and forms about 8.3% of India's overall retail market. Demand is culturally anchored in weddings, festivals, births and the harvest season, and gold doubles as a savings asset, particularly in rural India.
